init --from definition.json --slug sample --operator sam
add "first card"
add "second card"
add "third card"
add "fourth card"
add "fifth card"
add "sixth card"
add "seventh card"
comment sample-1 "a first comment"
comment sample-1 "a second comment"
archive sample-1/comments/1
attach sample-1 payload-one.txt
attach sample-1 payload-two.txt
attach sample-1/attachments/1 payload-two.txt --replace
delete sample-1/attachments/2 --yes
attach sample-1 payload-three.txt --description "the third payload"
archive sample-1/attachments/2
attach sample-1 payload-two.txt --description "the surviving payload"
rename sample-1/attachments/1 renamed-payload.txt
claim sample-2
release sample-2
claim sample-3 --expires 8h
block sample-4 "a vendor has not answered" --kind external
unblock sample-4
block sample-5 "a second obstacle" --kind external
move sample-6 doing
archive sample-6
claim sample-7 --expires 200ms
wait 400ms
show sample-7
move sample-2 doing
move sample-3 doing
move sample-7 doing --override
add "eighth card"
delete sample-8 --yes
archive done
workbench set title "Sample workbench, renamed"
workbench set title "Sample workbench"
workbench set operator sam
workstream new "Portfolio work"
workstream new "Console redesign"
workstream set portfolio-work status paused
join sample-2 portfolio-work
join sample-3 portfolio-work
leave sample-3 portfolio-work
archive workstream/console-redesign
